title: detector_graph
description: EchoForge detector_graph document. Describes a signal-processing / detection pipeline as a directed graph of named nodes and edge specs (currently encoded as opaque strings; v2 will move to structured node and edge records). Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "detector_graph".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this detector graph is derived from (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

graph_name.description: Human-readable name of the detector graph (e.g. "cfar_then_dbscan_v1"); non-empty string.

nodes.description: Ordered node ids that make up the graph; structured node spec TBD in v2. At least one node required.

edges.description: Edge specs encoded as strings (e.g. "src_node->dst_node"); v2 will move to structured edge records. May be empty.
